description:
Extend the rust-build-budget checker with the exact optional `--test-suite-ms <integer>` interface while preserving its existing mandatory metadata and artifact inputs.

## Background

The checker defines `MAX_TEST_SUITE_SECONDS=30` once and follows the existing flag-based injection style at `scripts/rust-build-budget.sh:48`. An absent flag passes and skips this check so the checker can land before live runner wiring.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Accepts `--test-suite-ms <integer>` and defines the canonical threshold as the named constant `MAX_TEST_SUITE_SECONDS=30` in `scripts/rust-build-budget.sh`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Skips the suite-duration check and passes when the flag is absent; reports a checker error and fails for a non-integer, negative, or empty value; and fails when the value is greater than or equal to `MAX_TEST_SUITE_SECONDS*1000`, including the exact threshold.
- [hard] REQ-03: Covers the five fixtures absent, malformed (non-integer/negative/empty), under-threshold (29,999 ms passes), at-threshold (30,000 ms fails), and over-threshold in `rust_build_budget_checker_tests.rs` while preserving mandatory metadata and artifact inputs.
title: Add the injectable suite duration checker
